metadata.title: Affiliate Program | joymagic
metadata.description: Join the joymagic affiliate program and earn commissions from first orders and renewals.

hero.title: Turn your audience into recurring revenue
hero.description: Join the joymagic affiliate program. When a user registers within your 7-day attribution window and completes a paid order, the referral is bound to that account, and later renewals continue to belong to you.
trust: Cross-device purchase attribution after account binding

why.title: Why this program works
why.description: Built for creators, educators, design communities, AI directories, and KOLs who want to turn existing traffic into durable revenue.

how.title: How commissions work
how.description: The path is simple and transparent. Share your referral link and let the system handle the tracking.

steps.title: 1. Apply
steps.description: Submit your channel details, social profile, and PayPal payout information.

steps.title: 2. Get approved
steps.description: After approval, a unique affiliate code is generated and sent to you by email.

steps.title: 3. Share your link
steps.description: Once visitors click your link, first-click attribution is locked to you for 7 days.

steps.title: 4. Earn commissions
steps.description: If the user registers within the window, later purchases on that account continue to belong to you.

items.question: What if the user clicks my link and then someone else’s within 7 days?
items.answer: The referral is still yours. We use a 7-day first-click lock, so later clicks inside the active window do not overwrite the original affiliate.

items.question: Do I still get commission if the user buys on another device after registering?
items.answer: Yes. Once the user registers within your valid attribution window, the referral is bound to the account, so later purchases on other devices still belong to you.

items.question: Do you support both first-order and renewal commissions?
items.answer: Yes. First orders and renewals use separate rates, and KOL partners can also receive custom rates.

items.question: When can I request a payout?
items.answer: After a successful payment, commissions enter a confirmation period and become withdrawable after the default 3-day delay. Once you reach the minimum payout threshold, you can request a PayPal payout.
